beats.intro: Chapter sixty-five. [[sub]]One formula solves every quadratic equation: the quadratic formula.
beats.where: Where does it come from? Complete the square on a x squared plus b x plus c equals zero, using letters instead of numbers. [[div]]Divide by a, and move c over. [[half]]Add the square of b over two a to both sides. [[fac]]The left side becomes x plus b over two a, squared. The right side becomes b squared minus four a c, over four a squared. [[root]]Take square roots of both sides, [[ans]]then subtract b over two a. [[f]]That's the quadratic formula: x equals negative b, plus or minus the square root of b squared minus four a c, all over two a.
beats.use: To use it, first write the equation as a x squared plus b x plus c equals zero. [[ex]]Take two x squared minus seven x plus three equals zero. [[abc]]Read off a, b, and c: two, negative seven, and three. [[sub]]Put them into the formula. Be careful with the signs: negative b is negative negative seven, which is seven. [[rad]]Under the radical, forty-nine minus twenty-four is twenty-five. [[root]]The square root of twenty-five is five. [[two]]So x is seven plus five over four, or seven minus five over four. [[ans]]That's three, or one half.
beats.graph: Check with a graph. [[par]]The parabola y equals two x squared minus seven x plus three [[cross]]crosses the x-axis at exactly one half and three. [[mid]]Notice that negative b over two a, seven fourths, sits halfway between them. The plus or minus part reaches the same distance to each side.
beats.q1: Quick check. Read off a, b, and c.
beats.irr: The formula also handles answers that aren't whole numbers. [[ex]]Solve two x squared plus four x minus five equals zero. [[sub]]a is two, b is four, c is negative five. [[rad]]Under the radical, sixteen minus four times two times negative five is sixteen plus forty, fifty-six. [[simp]]The square root of fifty-six is two root fourteen. [[red]]Divide everything by two: [[ans]]x equals negative two plus or minus root fourteen, over two. [[approx]]That's about one point three seven, or negative three point three seven.
beats.q2: Quick check. Use the quadratic formula.
beats.first: Remember to get zero on one side first. [[ex]]For three x minus one, squared, equals four, [[exp]]expand and subtract four: nine x squared minus six x minus three equals zero. [[ans]]Then the formula gives one and negative one third. [[which]]Factoring, square roots, completing the square, or the formula: any method that works gives the same answers. The formula always works.
beats.wrap: To sum up. [[w1]]Write the equation as a x squared plus b x plus c equals zero. [[w2]]x equals negative b, plus or minus the square root of b squared minus four a c, all over two a. [[w3]]Watch the signs when you substitute, and simplify the radical. [[end]]Now try the chapter practice.
beats.final1: Chapter practice. Solve with the formula.
beats.final3: Last one. Get zero on one side first.
beats.finish: Excellent. That's the end of chapter sixty-five, the quadratic formula.
